description: Defines enums, functions, and a struct for MAC logical channel configuration, including prioritized bit rate, bucket size duration, and logical channel parameters, following 3GPP specifications.

classes.name: mac_lc_config
classes.description: Configuration parameters for MAC logical channels, including priority, bit rate, bucket size, and SR settings.

methods.name: to_prioritized_bit_rate
methods.description: Converts an unsigned value to a prioritized_bit_rate enum, with error handling for invalid values.

methods.name: to_bucket_size_duration
